sections.heading: What is Repeat Purchase Rate?
paragraphs: Repeat Purchase Rate (RPR), also known as Repeat Customer Rate, measures the percentage of customers who have made more than one purchase from your business. It's a direct indicator of customer loyalty, product satisfaction, and the overall health of your brand. A higher rate signals that your products and customer experience are meeting expectations.

sections.heading: Why is Repeat Purchase Rate Important?

bullets.label: Cost Efficiency
bullets.text: Acquiring new customers costs 5-7x more than retaining existing ones

bullets.label: Higher Profitability
bullets.text: Repeat customers spend more per order and have higher lifetime value

bullets.label: Brand Health
bullets.text: A high RPR indicates strong customer satisfaction and brand loyalty

bullets.label: Sustainable Growth
bullets.text: Some brands barely break even on first sales. Profit comes from repeat purchases

bullets.label: Predictable Revenue
bullets.text: Repeat customers create more stable, predictable revenue streams

sections.heading: Why Industry Rates Vary
paragraphs: Products like groceries, supplements, and pet food require regular repurchasing, naturally boosting repeat rates.
Furniture, electronics, and luxury items are infrequent purchases. Customers may not return for months or years.
Chewy reports 78% of sales from Autoship subscriptions. Subscriptions dramatically increase repeat purchase behavior.

sections.heading: How to Improve Your Repeat Purchase Rate

bullets.label: Launch a Loyalty Program
bullets.text: 1. Reward repeat purchases with points, discounts, or exclusive perks

bullets.label: Offer Subscriptions
bullets.text: 2. Auto-replenishment for consumables ensures regular repeat purchases

bullets.label: Personalize Communications
bullets.text: 3. Targeted emails based on purchase history drive 2nd and 3rd orders

bullets.label: Excellent Customer Service
bullets.text: 4. Quick resolutions turn one-time buyers into loyal customers

bullets.label: Post-Purchase Engagement
bullets.text: 5. Follow up after delivery with tips, related products, and review requests
